reason: The frozen method fixes color roles, values, content, matrix, major frame/panel widths, isolation and accessibility floors but leaves judgment-bearing carrier defaults that must not be silently chosen after visual evidence exists.
invariants: No family/control hex value, role allocation, hue topology, emphasis order, matrix member, accessibility floor, review task, failure rule or no-retune law changes.
APP and WEB differ only where the parent method already authorizes context-specific frame/panel width and exact context color values.
All family/control specimens use identical carrier geometry, typography, spacing and element order within the same viewport class.

role_resolution.primary_text: P1 heading, P2 body, P3 text, P5 text
role_resolution.accent_strip: one 32x3 CSS px aria-hidden decorative strip before P1; carries no state, action, relationship or eligibility meaning
role_resolution.action: transparent field fill with accent text and 2px accent border; the optional filled-accent variant is not used in CLR-01
role_resolution.focus: 3px double accent outline with 3px offset on :focus-visible; double-outline geometry makes focus distinguishable independently of hue

forced_colors_resolution.principle: Use native forced-color substitution. Do not preserve candidate colors with forced-color-adjust:none.
forced_colors_resolution.panel_and_rows: Canvas/CanvasText-compatible structure; required borders remain present
forced_colors_resolution.action: ButtonText/Canvas-compatible border/text; focused action uses a 3px double Highlight outline
forced_colors_resolution.pass_condition: All frozen text remains present, row/action structure remains identifiable, and focus remains geometrically visible when candidate colors are suppressed.

diagnostic_defaults.normal_mode: browser-computed styles and geometry for all 24 cells
diagnostic_defaults.review_mode: labels may be visible outside the scored carrier as permitted by the parent method; no anonymous/blinded-review claim

non_authority: These values are CLR-01 execution-fixture defaults only.
They are not production spacing, typography, radius, focus, color, theme or component tokens.
They create no website/app implementation, semantic-status color, Stage-motion, final-identity or Phase-C authority.
